# Public address regression fixture

`gnaf_addresses.json` contains published government office addresses, not
customer or residential data. It gives the parser a small deterministic
regression set in a clean checkout. The larger G-NAF corpus can still replace
this file for local accuracy runs.

Sources:

- [School Infrastructure NSW](https://pre.schoolinfrastructure.nsw.gov.au/contact-us.html)
- [VicRoads office locations](https://www.vicroads.vic.gov.au/contact-us/officelocations)
- [Queensland Legal Services Commission](https://www.lsc.qld.gov.au/contact-us)
- [South Australian Department for Housing and Urban Development](https://www.sa.gov.au/topics/about-sa/government/departments/department-for-housing-and-urban-development)
- [Western Australian Electoral Commission](https://www.elections.wa.gov.au/contact-us)
- [Tasmania Police stations](https://www.police.tas.gov.au/contact-us/find-your-local-police-station/)
- [artsACT](https://www.arts.act.gov.au/functions/contact-us)
- [Northern Territory Director of Public Prosecutions](https://dpp.nt.gov.au/about-us/contact-information)
